critical_section.installer: cloud/task088_v5_install/release/install_package.py:479-480 obtains publication flock then SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE before source/inventory/DB validation and backup/install.

critical_section.db_fence_interpretation: A DB writer need not itself acquire the publication flock to be excluded by SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE. The distinct .crm_db.lock is therefore not, alone, a defect. This does not protect filesystem work before DB access or after a committed DB transaction.
